data.caption: Interaction flow for Uber Ride Sharing. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as UberRideSharingService
    participant RI as Rider
    participant DR as Driver
    participant TR as Trip
    participant LO as Location

    C->>S: Request
    S->>DR: RequestRide()
    DR-->>S: Result
    S->>TR: AcceptTrip()
    TR-->>S: Result
    S->>LO: StartTrip()
    LO-->>S: Result
    S->>LO: CompleteTrip()
    LO-->>S: Result
    S-->>C: Response

data.title: uber-ride-sharing.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Uber Ride Sharing demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
